The '''2017–18 Eredivisie''' was the 62nd season of the [[Eredivisie]] since its establishment in 1955. The season began on 11 August 2017 and concluded on 6 May 2018; the Europa League and relegation play-offs took place later that month. [[Feyenoord]] were the defending champions from the [[2016–17 Eredivisie|previous season]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/football/2017/05/17/dirk-kuyt-retires-champion-title-clinching-hat-trick-feyenoord/|title=Dirk Kuyt retires a champion after title-clinching hat-trick for Feyenoord|last=Gibson|first=Sean|date=17 May 2017|work=[[The Daily Telegraph]]|access-date=10 August 2017}}</ref> On 15 April 2018, [[PSV Eindhoven|PSV]] became champions for the 24th time after defeating their closest rival Ajax 3–0 at the [[Philips Stadion]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/43776657
|title = PSV 3 Ajax 0|date=15 April 2018|work=BBC Sport|access-date=16 April 2018}}</ref>

== Teams ==
A total of 18 teams took part in the league: The best fifteen teams from the [[2016–17 Eredivisie|2016–17 season]], two promotion/relegation playoff winners ([[Roda JC]] and [[NAC Breda]]) and the [[2016–17 Eerste Divisie]] champions ([[VVV-Venlo]]).
